player_intent: Keep both AK/M4 hands and elbows natural through left strafe, direction changes and stopping, with a high shouldered stock on A and unchanged crosswise carry on D.
acceptance_rule: Actual standing/crouch A/D and stop transitions preserve 5 mm palm contact, 0.5 degree accepted-shot bore alignment and 42–150 degree elbow limits; saved pocket calibration remains within the shoulder region and is exactly absent at full D. Other weapon profiles default to zero.

nodes.role: The existing authored weapon owner applies a saved shoulder-pocket calibration and solves its unchanged fixed palms.

visual_check: Native A/D front and side review must show shouldered A stock, natural wrists, no folded support arm on stop, and unchanged full-D rifle in front of the torso.

system_delta.reason: A measured 0.065m shoulder-pocket calibration, -15 degree wrist roll, trigger-first entry pivot and existing bounded contact iterations pass 4536 actual AK/M4 rows across three gait phases, plus the strict stock gate. Camera/movement/shot owners and full-D remain unchanged. Native review and 32-player performance remain separate gates.
